text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, invited by Yaeno Muteki,
I was heading towards her hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To run without holding back and giving everything to my burning passion,
there is something I must do.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To face myself—
the very thing I've averted my eyes from the most.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why am I so incapable of controlling my passions,
always acting so recklessly...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You must face your true essence
and unravel the cause behind this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, to face my past,
I wish to emulate the training of the Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, we have arrived.
Now then, let us proceed to the land of recollection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting off the train, we headed straight into the mountains.
She said we were going to the place where they meditate during dojo training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we walked along the mountain path, Yaeno Muteki
began to speak about the doubts weighing on her heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I had been avoiding
facing myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because... doing so would mean
confronting the depths of one's own ugliness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why do such ugly emotions arise,
the desire to brandish power and bend others to one's will...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if I reach the essence of ugliness,
what if there's nothing but ugliness inside me...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When I think about that... I'm scared to face it.
choice_data_list: You know you can quit if you want, right?
You know you can quit if you want, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...No! Even so, I want to move forward.
I choose the path of acquiring new weapons to become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To build an era for myself and my rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if to shake off any hesitation, Yaeno Muteki let determination seep into her impassioned words.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"—This is where we conduct
our meditation training in the Kongo Yaegaki style."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To approach meditation with a proper mind and body,
Yaeno Muteki had donned her formal attire:
her racing Racewear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall now enter meditation
to face my own heart and perceive its true essence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told them that just like when we performed the kata forms together,
there might be something they can intuitively grasp."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...! That is so reassuring...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well then—...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Why am I so desperate not to let my emotions take over
and become who I used to be...?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—The reason is plain as day.
For no one desires such a foolish, contemptible version of me.)

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut up!
You're weak, so stop defying me! Stop complaining!!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then let's settle this with a match!!
Whoever wins is the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah! I can't believe this!
Let's go play over there instead!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
...Yaeno-chan is scary, so I don't like her...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Though some obeyed out of fear of my violent behavior,
everyone feared me. ...They hated me.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Naturally. Who would welcome such arrogant behavior, bending reason with force and pushing things through unreasonably?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't think it was right, either...
I knew it was wrong, yet I couldn't bring myself to stop.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because if I didn't make them obey through force,
no one would accept me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "I was always irritable and quick to anger. It was inevitable that I would be hated. Yet, I did not wish to be hated."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I flaunted my power to make them accept me!
I forced them to acknowledge me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I just wanted to be accepted...
...I didn't want to be hated..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Vile, crude, and good-for-nothing as I am,
I still found myself wishing for your acknowledgment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"What lies at the root of my crude behavior...
The true essence of this fiery passion is—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's a wretched, intense desire for self-display—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Suppressing the raging flame means suppressing the 'desire for self-display.'
If one has no craving for recognition,
one will not resort to crude behavior.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Once I suppressed my emotions and stopped throwing my power around,
everyone stopped hating me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me was accepted.
As long as I don't let my emotions sway me, I am accepted.
—Really?

"Are you truly no longer swayed by your emotions?
Can you really say you are suppressing your need for attention?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you flaunting your self-absorbed
desire for attention even right now?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Furious that Miss Oguri is seen as the generation's representative,
she's determined to make them acknowledge her!
She's shouting for everyone to look at her!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I want to overturn the general consensus,
and make everyone acknowledge that this is my era now!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I haven't changed at all!
I haven't grown in the slightest!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even now, she is once again
waving around her purely selfish desire for attention!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, it's impossible...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If someone like me were to run purely on instinct,
laying all my emotions bare...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Running wild, just like in the past...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure I'll throw another tantrum, overpowering others with brute force,
flaunting my existence... howling at them to praise me, and not to hate me..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, let's throw a tantrum, overpower others by force, and show off our presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, I ask whether the strength Yaeno Muteki wishes to wield is merely the same violence as in her past.
choice_data_list: Or maybe the power in those legs kicking the turf?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's true nature has never changed.
An intense desire to make her presence known.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I merely wished to be praised.
Even through violence, it didn't matter.
So long as I could flaunt that I stood above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, now is different. Having learned the Kongo Yaegaki style,
I acquired the method to channel my power into the earth.
And I threw myself into the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—we met.
Rivals pushing each other to win.
Irreplaceable comrades weathering this fierce era together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Formidable rivals, each possessing a different kind of strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the strong who ignite an obsession to surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From competing alongside them,
Yaeno Muteki's desire to prove herself
is now directed squarely at racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then what is so wrong with letting your heart boil,
seizing 1st place with sheer strength,and bringing everyone else to their knees?"
choice_data_list: Because that's what an Umamusume race is all about, isn't it?
Because that's what an Umamusume race is all about, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Even if I run with my raw emotions laid bare...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Will they... dislike me...?
choice_data_list: Do you really think people will hate you after seeing your tenacity?
Do you really think everyone will dislike you for showing your obsession?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno's always calm and composed, sure, but...
Is she really giving it everything she's got, though?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you were holding back on me!
You've got way more in the tank than that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I feel like I've gotten
a little closer to the real Yaeno-chan, and that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You kept running to strike a blow against Miss Oguri and the others,
to overturn overwhelming public opinion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Yaeno stick to her own style
even amidst the tremendous cheers for Oguri...
inspired me."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone that I've competed with...
choice_data_list: Everyone recognizes your talent, so you'll be fine.
Everyone acknowledges you, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Right, that happened...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You are all competitors who respect each other's strength...
I fought on, honing myself as we each strove to surpass one another...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whether it's desiring victory out of vanity, or running wild driven by pure passion...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If it's all of you, I'm sure you will—...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I will challenge it
running true to my heart, without suppressing my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm still a little scared, but...
I'll put my faith in everyone."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I believed that everyone would approve of
this path I chose in order to grow stronger."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flames are reflected in Yaeno Muteki's eyes.
They were fierce, brilliant flames,
swirling and blazing within her—
